messages:
maya (AE): FinCorp legal escalated: POC ok but strict EU-only for day-to-day. They will allow a documented DR jump to non-EU only under declared incident with audit. BYO-KMS via Azure KV required. They asked for: subproc roster, short KMS integration checklist, and high-level pricing delta for 'standby DR' vs 'EU-reserved'. Need by Friday.

oliver (Solutions Eng): Quick: does the DR path have to be explicit IP/cidr restricted? Or is 'region outside EU' sufficient? Also confirm if they want snapshot/local storage residency guarantees for logs.

maya (AE): Not IP-level. They want "regional" guarantee: EU day-to-day, any non-EU only on declared incident. Logs must be retained in EU for normal ops; cross-region logs only if DR Firecall invoked.

sara (Security PM): We can provide: EU subproc list (data plane and infra), SOC2 + ISO artifacts, and a KMS checklist. For Azure KV we require customer to create a key with 'unwrapKey' for Redwood's service principal and to additionally enable key rotation alerts to their sec ops. I'll prepare checklist and a short attestation template.

nate (Sales Eng): Customer asked for a sample contract clause they can show legal that locks normal ops to EU and defines the DR activation process. Can we provide a short template?

legal-bot: Uploaded: eu_subproc_roster_2026.pdf and kms-checklist-azurekv_v1.txt to /shared/fin_corp/docs. Draft DR clause template saved as DR-activation-clause_v0.1.md (sales+legal+sec access).

oliver (Solutions Eng): Runtime options we discussed with Tom: (A) Tenant pinned to EU-dedicated pool (formal isolation); (B) Region-affinity routing with explicit 'manual DR activation' flag and audit trail. Tradeoffs: A gives strongest legal posture but usually requires reservation (cost up). B is more flexible but needs strong operational controls + playbook.

tom (Runtime Eng): Sample routing policy for option B (to include in appendix):
```
{"policy":"tenant_routing","tenant":"FinCorp","primary_region":"eu-central-1","fallback_region":"us-east-1","fallback_activation":"manual","audit_hook":"capture_fallthrough_event","notes":"fallback only after executive signoff, logged to audit stream"}
```
This enforces EU primary and logs any manual fallback activation.

oliver (Solutions Eng): We'll add a dry-run mode that simulates DR activation without switching traffic so FinCorp can validate audit logs. Good demo for the POC.

nate (Sales Eng): Pricing ballpark request from them: compare "standby DR (on-demand)" vs "EU reserved". Any quick numbers?

tom (Runtime Eng): Ballpark: standby DR (EU primary hosted + occasional DR) adds ~12-20% on unit cost assuming DR invoked rarely; the lift is mainly cross-region egress and buffer capacity for cold bursts. EU reserved (pinned capacity) tends to be +30-45% depending on commit length and headroom. If they need stricter SLA on failover time we should assume higher premium. Precise quote needs QPS and retention.

maya (AE): I'll ask FinCorp for sample QPS, typical daily tokens, and acceptable RTO. Also ask if they want a DR runbook signoff step in contract.

sara (Security PM): Note: for BYO-KMS (Azure KV) we cannot hold plaintext keys. We need key wrap/unwarp only. Customer's sec team must allow our service principal to call wrapKey/unwrapKey or use key-encryption-key flow. Documented MOU must state key rotation and emergency access procedures.

nate (Sales Eng): I'll send the interim note to FinCorp: linking the roster+checklist and confirming next steps for getting QPS data.

ops-oncall: EU pool headroom check: currently eu-central dedicated pool has ~30% spare on average; we can support a short-term tenant pin for a POC but for production-scale reserved pins we need a capacity request. No special infra required for Azure KV integration beyond the service principal permissions mentioned.

maya (AE): Perfect. Target deliverables: 1) subproc roster + SOC artifacts (sec) 2) KMS checklist + MOU draft (sec+legal) 3) sample routing policy + dry-run plan (eng) 4) ballpark pricing ranges and POC timeline (sales). Aim to get these to FinCorp by Friday COB.

oliver (Solutions Eng): I'll draft POC runbook and schedule a 30m tech kickoff. Will include steps: prepare keys, apply routing policy in dry-run, trigger simulated DR event, validate audit trail.

maya (AE): Thanks. If anyone hits blockers escalate here.
